title: POPULAR, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Popular, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 23, 2026, disclosing unaudited financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026 (Q1 2026) pursuant to Item 2.02, and furnishing a conference call presentation under Item 7.01. Exhibits 99.1 (press release) and 99.2 (conference call presentation) are attached but their full text is not included in the 8-K body. The filing also lists the registrant's securities — Common Stock (BPOP) and 6.125% Cumulative Monthly Income Trust Preferred Securities (BPOPM) — traded on NASDAQ.
key_points: Popular, Inc. filed Form 8-K on April 23, 2026, reporting Q1 2026 unaudited financial results.
Results were disclosed under Item 2.02 (Results of Operations and Financial Condition), referencing Exhibit 99.1.
A conference call presentation (Exhibit 99.2) was furnished under Item 7.01 (Regulation FD Disclosure).
Full content of the press release and presentation is not present in the 8-K body text provided.
Traded securities: Common Stock BPOP and preferred securities BPOPM, both on NASDAQ.
Filed by Senior Vice President and Corporate Comptroller Denissa M. Rodríguez on April 23, 2026.
